SECTION C: (3 Marks Each)

Q29. Prove that:
(tanθ)/(1−cotθ) + (cotθ)/(1−tanθ) = 1 + secθ cosecθ

Answer / Solution:
Convert tan and cot to sin/cos.
LHS = (sinθ/cosθ)/(1 - cosθ/sinθ) + (cosθ/sinθ)/(1 - sinθ/cosθ)
= sin^2θ/[cosθ(sinθ - cosθ)] + cos^2θ/[sinθ(cosθ - sinθ)]
= (sin^3θ - cos^3θ)/[sinθ cosθ (sinθ - cosθ)]
Using a^3 - b^3 = (a-b)(a^2 + b^2 + ab):
= (sinθ - cosθ)(sin^2θ + cos^2θ + sinθ cosθ)/[sinθ cosθ (sinθ - cosθ)]
= (1 + sinθ cosθ)/(sinθ cosθ)
= 1 + 1/(sinθ cosθ) = 1 + secθ cosecθ
Hence proved.
